item.title: First post!
item.description: knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE) Hello, world! Thanks for taking the time to read my first blog post! While I am trained as a social psychologist, I’m a big proponent of leveraging data science tools to understand the world around us. Thus, I plan to discuss a mixture of data-driven topics and insights here. I hope to use this blog as a place to write about things that interest me, but focus will likely be on statistics, research methods, open science, social psychology, and data science.
